fusions.name: Tripwire Quarrel
fusions.desc: Trips a crossbow held at full draw. Its bolt deals 30 damage to a target up to 9 tiles away, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach, ignores armour and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Loaded Rack
fusions.desc: Trips a rack of set bows that looses 3 arrows in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each arrow deals 3 damage, with 30% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Spring Gun
fusions.desc: Stakes a cocked crossbow into the ground for 12 seconds. It shoots an enemy within 6 tiles every 1.5 seconds for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
